epistemic_assessments.rationale: Standards 3, 7, 9 and 11 are expressed as testable conditions with defined pass criteria, and across six meetings 64 of 71 assessments conformed with no discussion and none was overturned by the Authority.
The contact effectiveness against data minimisation item is cross-domain, has no defined pass criteria, and the minutes record genuine disagreement.
tda-tor-v4 section 5 states that Gate 2 approval is reserved to the Authority and may not be delegated. In force at the relevant time.
No source establishes who may amend the terms of reference to permit delegated standard approvals.
epistemic_assessments.question_asked: Who may amend tda-tor-v4 section 5 to permit delegation of standard pattern approvals?
epistemic_assessments.scope_searched: tda-tor-v4 in full; TDA minutes 2025-09 to 2026-02; arch-standards-v11; smf-responsibilities-2025-12.

payload.current_state: Monthly forum spending roughly 50 of 80 scheduled minutes on deterministic conformance against four testable standards, preceded by 3 analyst-days of manual dashboard assembly, with one genuine cross-domain trade-off per cycle.
payload.next_nudge: Precompute the Standards 3, 7, 9 and 11 conformance assessment continuously and deliver it to the Authority as evidence, rather than assembling it by hand for each meeting. The Authority continues to approve; what changes is who assembles the evidence and when.
jobs_unchanged: Escalation of retention matters to the Data Governance Council
jobs_delegable_with_bounds: Standard pattern approvals where all four testable standards pass and no exception is claimed — NOT available now, see new_authority_or_delegation_required
jobs_requiring_human_or_independent_judg: Contact effectiveness against data minimisation, and cross-domain trade-offs generally
Application of Standards 1, 2, 4-6, 8 and 10, which the register states require judgement
payload.new_evidence_capability: Continuous conformance assessment against the four testable standards, produced from the four source systems rather than assembled from them by an analyst.
payload.new_authority_or_delegation_required: Precomputing the evidence requires no new authority — the Authority still decides. Moving standard pattern approvals to a delegated path is FORECLOSED by tda-tor-v4 section 5 and would require amendment of the terms of reference by whoever holds that authority, which the estate does not establish. This projection does not recommend that change; it names the gate.
preconditions: Precomputed assessments produced in parallel with the manual dashboard for at least three cycles
Every divergence between precomputed and manual assessment investigated and explained
The four source systems' coverage of the estate confirmed
success_evidence: Precomputed and manual assessments agree across three cycles, with divergences explained
Analyst assembly effort measurably reduced from the 3 person-days baseline
No Gate 2 decision changed by the substitution
stop_conditions: The Authority overturns a precomputed conformance assessment
Any of Standards 3, 7, 9, 11 is reclassified from testable to judgement
Conformance rate moves materially without an explained cause
Divergence between precomputed and manual assessment in more than one cycle
known_unknowns: Who may amend the terms of reference
Whether the four source systems cover the whole estate
Whether the Authority's independence from assured delivery is affected by taking evidence from a shared pipeline
population_monitoring_required: Conformance rate by standard, tracked for drift
Every case where a precomputed pass would have been overturned by the Authority
Changes assessed as conforming that later generate an incident or exception
independent_challenge_requirements: Precomputation supplies evidence to the Authority; it must not become the decision
The Authority must retain the ability to reach a different conclusion from the precomputed assessment, and every such case is recorded
payload.accountability_terminus_requirement: A named individual must be accountable for the precomputed conformance assessment before it is relied on. The reconstruction found no named terminus for the Authority itself, which must be resolved first.
payload.reassessment_trigger: After three cycles of parallel running, or on any stop condition.

required_authority: None for the precomputation itself. Amendment of tda-tor-v4 section 5 would be required before any delegated approval path, and the holder of that authority is UNKNOWN.
caveat: This is one bounded step, not a target operating model. Nothing here proposes that the Authority meet less often or approve fewer things.
prohibited_inference: That 64 of 71 conformances mean the Authority is unnecessary
That Standards 1, 2, 4-6, 8, 10 can be precomputed because they rarely appear in minutes
That precomputing evidence permits delegating the decision
